name: noHorizon
title: A replay stamped with its restart day is checked only against that day's partition, misses its original, and is inserted twice
instance: noHorizon (HORIZON = 0 < MAX_DAY = 1; writer faults on; TTL 6)
timing: model time is in ticks; a worker's fence = sent + TTL - MARGIN - BUDGET, its statement lands by fence + BUDGET + SLACK, another worker may take the lane at sent + TTL + MARGIN (MARGIN = BUDGET = 1 tick); the day is a separate calendar clock; an epoch's objects carry the day its incarnation started (eDay)

steps.action: PUT e1/000 with request 1 on day 0; S3 commits it; the 200 is lost (no ack)
the edge restarts: new incarnation, epoch 2, named on day 1
replays request 1 (never acked) into e2/000, stamped day 1; S3 commits it
check e1/0 over day 0 +- 0: absent; send INSERT S1
FATAL: check e2/0 over day 1 +- 0 only: the original in day 0 is out of range, so the copy reads as absent

violated.invariant: atMostOnce (and the horizon audit's auditLate is raised: dupAudited holds)

design.guard: HORIZON >= MAX_DAY: the check reads the object's day +- HORIZON; and, since 2026-09-27, received_at is the custody time, so an edge replay carries day 0 anyway (see restamp.json)
design.effect: at step 9 the check over days 0..2 sees the day-0 copy; the pending set is empty and no S2 is sent (noHorizonDesignTest on designCopies/designDays)
design.code: D11: a 3-day copy horizon plus the horizon audit (consumer_late_copies_total); D19: the Quiver WAL write / s3pq enqueue time is received_at and a replay keeps it

dropped: the edge's startPush/send/apply merged in steps 1 and 4; the lost 200 is implicit (the response is never received)
